startupControl.meaning: The same large artifact reaches its native selector without running any Script or in-image compilation.

workingExecution.meaning: In-image compilation, publication, invocation and repeated returned-callback template identity passed for this case.

protocol: Run the already-published, hash-verified artifact through the direct debugserver protocol established by the selector-only control. No compiler/runtime source changed between these attempts.
limits: A transient launch failure is consistent with these controls, but its root cause and the launch/execution timing split of the first timeout remain unknown. Prior failed observations remain retained. This is not complete native acceptance or Test262 conformance.
